summary_en: Accenture has launched a tender offer to acquire all ordinary shares of Global Security Experts Inc. (TSE Growth: 4417) at 8,500 yen per share, with a tender period from November 2 to December 15, 2026 (30 business days). The minimum number of shares to be acquired is 983,100. The target company's board has expressed support and recommended shareholder participation in the offer.
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Shares of Global Security Experts Inc. (Security Code: 4417) by Accenture Inc.
translation_en_brief: On October 30, 2026, Accenture Inc. announced the commencement of a tender offer to acquire all ordinary shares of Global Security Experts Inc. (TSE Growth: 4417) at a price of 8,500 yen per share. The tender offer period runs from November 2 to December 15, 2026 (30 business days). The minimum number of shares to be acquired is 983,100 shares, with no stated upper limit. The offer also includes new share warrants issued by the target company, with warrants priced at 1 yen each. Restricted stock compensation shares awarded to directors and executive officers (excluding outside directors) totaling 99,276 shares are also included in the offer. The target company's board of directors has expressed support for the tender offer and recommended that shareholders participate. The board has determined that warrant holders should make their own decision on whether to participate, noting the minimal warrant price of 1 yen. The transaction is structured as part of a broader effort to take the target company private (make its shares non-public). The target company will exclude from the offer its own treasury shares and shares held through its J-ESOP (share attribution trust) arrangement held by Japan Custody Bank. The disclosure does not provide the total number of issued shares excluding treasury shares, preventing calculation of the percentage of shares sought relative to outstanding shares.
